newsitem.title: MEXICO: Gruma, Maseca to receive syndicated loan - bank.
newsitem.headline: Gruma, Maseca to receive syndicated loan - bank.

text.p: Bank of America will launch a three-year $120 million syndicated loan for Gruma SA and Grupo Industrial Maseca on April 4, Bank of America vice-president and business director Lorenzo Gonzalez Bosco said in an interview.
"We are going forward with a syndication of $120 million for three years for Gruma-Maseca," he said.
Gruma is the holding company for corn flour giant Maseca, and the companies share corporate leadership.
Another Bank of America client, state-owned oil giant Petroleos Mexicanos, also has said it is looking to renew its U.S. commerical paper program this year.
"We do not know what the final amount (of the Pemex CP program) will be, but we know that it will be at least the $500 million program they had," he said.
